mapper.sql: id, name, username, phone, sex, id_number, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM staff
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
AND phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO staff (name, username, password, phone, sex, id_number, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) VALUES (#{name}, #{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{sex}, #{idNumber}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
